flags.title: Iceland voted ‘no’ – what it means is that the EU failed to make its case
flags.summary: In their referendum this past weekend, Icelanders rejected resuming EU accession talks but only by a narrow margin: 52.8 % against, 47.2 % in favour. This suggests that concerns over fishing, long linked to Icelanders’ sense of national identity, ultimately prevailed at the ballot box, triumphing over existential security threats and the broader geopolitical case for Europe. flags.title: Orbán-backed Brussels think tank MCC Brussels to close after funding cut
flags.summary: MCC Brussels, the Eurosceptic think tank established by Viktor Orbán’s government, is shutting down after losing its Hungarian state funding. Its director, Frank Furedi, resigned in protest, describing the decision to wind down the organisation as “unprofessional and childish.”
